title: I could not find what I was looking for

comments.body:
Hey Joe,

Could it be possible to give the complete code you're using for this widget and put it in a sandbox (template available [here](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/instantsearch-templates/tree/master/src/InstantSearch.js)). That would be a lot more straightforward to see what isn't behaving as you're expecting. 

Thanks!

I created a custom connector widget. I am trying to use a multiple selection select list. The refine functions only takes one selected value. How to do I refine on multiple selected values.
